shortDescription: MEXICO CITY, Sept 3 (Reuters) - Mexico’s consumer confidence index was 46.1 in August when adjusted for seasonal factors, the national statistics agency said on Thursday.The unadjusted index was 46.6 during the month.((Mexico City newsroom, +52 55 5282-7153, mexicocity.newsroom@reuters.com))

children: MEXICO CITY, Sept 3 (Reuters) - Mexico’s consumer confidence index was 46.1 in August when adjusted for seasonal factors, the national statistics agency said on Thursday.
The unadjusted index was 46.6 during the month.
